counterfactual_missing_items: Histopathologic confirmation of cyst type is not reported
No explicit exclusion of thyroglossal duct cyst or vallecular cyst by pathology
No solid enhancing component is described to suggest malignancy
decisive_items: 20×20 mm round cystic mass at the base of the tongue
33×31×27 mm well-defined cystic lesion in the midline of the tongue base
complete pharyngeal airway obstruction during both inspiration and expiration as the mass pulled the epiglottis down and backward
response.rationale: R5 directly names the cystic tongue-base mass identified on laryngoscopy and CT, which is the most likely diagnosis. C1 is a correlated append-only restatement of R5 with an added complication and should be discounted as a separate diagnostic entity. R3 is the downstream obstructive sleep apnea syndrome caused by the mass, while R2 and R4 are unrelated comorbidities.

rejected.why: OSA is a consequence of the obstructing cyst; the RDI and symptoms do not identify the underlying tongue-base lesion.
Hypertension is an incidental comorbidity with no diagnostic specificity for the tongue-base mass.
Diabetes is an incidental comorbidity with no diagnostic specificity for the tongue-base mass.
